subject: HIST
course_description: Examines the intellectual and social context of the American Revolution. Issues covered include the causes and development of revolutionary sentiment, the military conflict, diplomacy, economics, and American constitutional government.
course_notes: (Same as AMST 385 1) (Why did the Americans believe they must separate from Britain in the 1770s? How did they succeed, despite facing a strong professional army and the world's most powerful navy? We will follow the development of the Revolution from its beginnings in the 1760s right through to the adoption of the Constitution and the inauguration of the first president in 1789. Topics include: diplomatic and military history, history of ideas, the king and the British government, the condition of Native Americans, the role of enslaved Africans in the Revolution, the roles of women, the Loyalists, Religion, and German mercenaries. Two midterms, a final, and two short papers.)
